name: Kaniza Seriinu
source:
The prince of Cancer, the endlessly kind knight of sentimentality.

He is very nurturing and kind. Although he’s shy, once he gets to know someone he is very accommodating. He’s also very possessive and when he gets angry he stays at home and refuses to leave. He loves to be with the other princes, and longs to be with other people. He is surprisingly resolute when he makes up his mind about something.
